demonstrates: through the production core, ten invalid invocations — missing, cross, malformed, deceptive-prefix, deceptive-suffix and port-mismatched origins, missing host, GET and HEAD — were each refused as invocation_refused with zero session lookups, zero membership loads, zero audit writes and zero cookie serializations; a valid session did not compensate for a bad origin. A same-host scheme change is recorded as passing the host comparison, since transport security is not this rule's job
